# Mdm Ling Bakery — Mid-Autumn 2026

> 花月情长 · A Bond in Lasting Bloom. The complete Mid-Autumn 2026 collection from Mdm Ling Bakery, Singapore:
> 14 keepsake gift sets, 7 mooncake set combinations and 10 flavours.
> The packaging is the point: every piece is made to be kept and used long after the season.

## Key facts

- The baked mooncakes are Halal certified. The Premium Truffle Snowskin range (Set G) is
  NOT Halal certified; it is vegetarian, with no pork and no lard.
- 9 of the 14 keepsakes can be ordered online at https://www.mdmlingbakery.com. The rest are sold only at our
  Mid-Autumn booths.
- Free delivery within Singapore on orders above $100.
- $1 from every Painted Garden Box goes to the Breast Cancer Foundation.
- The Painted Garden artwork is by Singaporean artist Phuay Li Ying (@theworldofying).
- Customer enquiries: +65 8468 0201 (WhatsApp).

## Mooncake sets

- Set A · Traditional: 4 × Lotus with Melon Seeds and Yolk. Halal certified.
- Set B · Traditional: 4 × Lotus with Melon Seeds. Halal certified.
- Set C · Traditional: 2 × Lotus with Melon Seeds and Yolk; 2 × Lotus with Melon Seeds. Halal certified.
- Set D · Signature: 1 × Black Sesame Peanut Butter; 1 × Red Dates Longan; 1 × Belgian Double Chocolate; 1 × Emerald Pandan Golden Yolk. Halal certified.
- Set E · Signature & Traditional: 1 × Lotus with Melon Seeds and Yolk; 1 × Lotus with Melon Seeds; 1 × Black Sesame Peanut Butter; 1 × Red Dates Longan. Halal certified.
- Set F · Signature & Traditional: 1 × Lotus with Melon Seeds and Yolk; 1 × Lotus with Melon Seeds; 1 × Belgian Double Chocolate; 1 × Emerald Pandan Golden Yolk. Halal certified.
- Set G · Snowskin Truffle: 2 × Truffle Popping Candy; 2 × Truffle Pistachio Kunafa; 2 × Truffle Muscat Grape; 2 × Truffle Passionfruit. Not Halal certified.

## Mooncake flavours

- [Lotus with Melon Seeds and Yolk](https://midautumn2026.mdmlingbakery.com/#f-lotus-with-melon-seeds-and-yolk) — Smooth white lotus paste studded with melon seeds and wrapped around a golden salted egg yolk, baked the time honoured Cantonese way. The one everyone reaches for first.. Ingredients: White lotus paste, wheat flour, salted egg yolk 🌕, golden syrup, blended cooking oil (palm, peanut, sesame), melon seed, egg, milk.
- [Lotus with Melon Seeds](https://midautumn2026.mdmlingbakery.com/#f-lotus-with-melon-seeds) — Pure white lotus paste with melon seeds folded through, in a classic baked skin. Quiet, smooth and traditional, for those who like it simple.. Ingredients: White lotus paste, melon seed, wheat flour, golden syrup, blended cooking oil (palm, peanut, sesame), egg, milk.
- [Belgian Double Chocolate](https://midautumn2026.mdmlingbakery.com/#f-belgian-double-chocolate) — Created for the youngest at the table. Chocolate is a flavour children already know and love, so this is their first step into mooncakes: a double hit of chocolate in both the skin and the paste, finished with a pinch of Himalayan salt that sharpens the cocoa from the first bite to the last.. Ingredients: Chocolate lotus paste, Maruchi dough, chocolate paste (Master Martini), melon seeds, blended cooking oil (palm, peanut, sesame), cocoa powder, Himalayan salt.
- [Black Sesame Peanut Butter](https://midautumn2026.mdmlingbakery.com/#f-black-sesame-peanut-butter) — Created for parents and grandparents with a sweet tooth. Toasty black sesame meets smooth peanut butter, a nod to the black sesame and peanut pastes they grew up ordering at Singapore dessert stalls, carried in a soft Momoyama skin.. Ingredients: Black sesame lotus paste, Maruchi dough, peanut butter, melon seeds, blended cooking oil (palm, peanut, sesame), pumpkin powder.
- [Emerald Pandan Golden Yolk](https://midautumn2026.mdmlingbakery.com/#f-emerald-pandan-golden-yolk) — Created for every generation. The sweet pandan fragrance everyone knows from kaya, carried in a modern Momoyama skin, with the golden yolk from the traditional mooncake at its centre. The best of both worlds in one bite.. Ingredients: Pandan paste, Maruchi dough, custard salted egg yolk paste 🌕, melon seed, blended cooking oil (palm, peanut, sesame), purple sweet potato powder.
- [Red Dates Longan](https://midautumn2026.mdmlingbakery.com/#f-red-dates-longan) — Created with our elders in mind. Red dates and longan are flavours they've known all their lives, long treasured in Chinese tradition as nourishing and warming, folded into a rose hued Momoyama skin. Gentle, familiar and easy to love.. Ingredients: Red date lotus, Maruchi dough, longan bits, melon seeds, blended cooking oil (palm, peanut, sesame), colour (102, 110, 124).
- [Truffle Muscat Grape](https://midautumn2026.mdmlingbakery.com/#f-truffle-muscat-grape) — A pale green snowskin of soft glutinous rice, filled with smooth lotus paste and a muscat grape truffle at its heart. Fragrant, delicate and quietly refreshing.. Ingredients: Cold water, icing sugar, glutinous rice flour, snowskin powder, shortening, cooking oil, lotus paste, muscat grape truffle (white couverture, cream, green tea powder, white grape flavour).
- [Truffle Passionfruit](https://midautumn2026.mdmlingbakery.com/#f-truffle-passionfruit) — A sunny golden snowskin of soft glutinous rice, filled with smooth lotus paste and a passionfruit truffle that lands bright and tangy. A little tropical sunshine that wakes the whole box up.. Ingredients: Cold water, icing sugar, glutinous rice flour, snowskin powder, shortening, cooking oil, lotus paste, passionfruit truffle (white couverture, Unigra passionfruit, cream).
- [Truffle Popping Candy](https://midautumn2026.mdmlingbakery.com/#f-truffle-popping-candy) — A blush pink snowskin of soft glutinous rice, filled with vivid dragonfruit paste and a popping candy truffle that crackles as you bite. The one that makes everyone at the table laugh first and reach for seconds after.. Ingredients: Cold water, icing sugar, glutinous rice flour, snowskin powder, shortening, cooking oil, dragon fruit paste (lotus paste, dragon fruit powder), popping candy truffle (white couverture, pink popping candy filling, blue popping candy filling).
- [Truffle Pistachio Kunafa](https://midautumn2026.mdmlingbakery.com/#f-truffle-pistachio-kunafa) — An ivory snowskin of soft glutinous rice, filled with smooth lotus paste and a rich pistachio kunafa truffle. Our nod to the beloved Middle Eastern dessert, reimagined for the mooncake table.. Ingredients: Cold water, icing sugar, glutinous rice flour, snowskin powder, shortening, cooking oil, lotus paste, pistachio kunafa truffle (milk couverture, almond filling, pistachio paste, pistachio nuts, feuilletine).
